caption: The drawing depicts a figure standing on a green rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a yellow long-sleeve shirt, a checkered black and white vest, and purple plaid pants with thin blue lines. It wears brown shoes, a red bow tie, and a brown hat with a beige brim. The figure's right arm is bent at the elbow, with a closed fist projecting forward, while the left arm rests on its hip. The face is rendered with exaggerated features and is colored black, with bright red lips and white teeth displayed in a broad smile. The composition is set against a plain, beige background, and the artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cast Iron Hitching Post
